metadata.purpose: Field-level data dictionary for TCO Excel template
metadata.description: Complete specification of all fields expected in TCO analysis

fields.validation_rules: Must be one of the allowed enum values
fields.business_meaning: Determines how cost is calculated: Fixed monthly, Variable monthly, Annual, or One-time implementation

fields.description: Date or version identifier for the proposal
fields.business_meaning: Identifies which proposal version this pricing comes from

fields.description: Average monthly quantity for variable fee calculations
fields.validation_rules: Positive number or 0. Required if fee_type = 'Monthly V'
fields.business_meaning: Used to calculate variable monthly costs: Cost = rate × quantity × 12

fields.description: Name of the product, service, or solution

fields.business_meaning: Groups similar products for reporting and analysis

fields.description: Price per unit (monthly, annual, or one-time)
fields.validation_rules: Numeric value, can be negative (for credits)
fields.business_meaning: Base rate used for all cost calculations

fields.validation_rules: Calculated field: depends on fee_type and per_unit_rate
fields.business_meaning: Monthly cost in first year of contract
Annual cost for Year 1 (Monthly × 12, Annual × 1, One-Time × 1)

fields.description: Total cost for subsequent years with CPI adjustment
Cost Price Index (inflation adjustment) for each year
Indicates if this is a third-party vendor (not primary vendor)
fields.business_meaning: Determines if payment goes to primary vendor or external party

fields.description: Indicates if solution is optional (not required for operations)
fields.business_meaning: Determines if included in base TCO calculation. Optional items shown separately.
Data quality indicator. Scores < 0.8 should be manually reviewed.

fields.description: AI-generated notes about extraction quality or assumptions
fields.business_meaning: Provides context for data quality and extraction decisions
examples: Core banking system pricing clearly defined
Quantity assumed based on industry averages

fields.description: Description of pricing unit (per transaction, per account, etc.)
Monthly fee from JSON (may differ from per_unit_rate)
fields.business_meaning: Direct monthly fee (if different from per-unit calculation)

fields.description: Implementation or setup fee from JSON
Current monthly fee (before proposal) for comparison
fields.business_meaning: Used to calculate cost increase/decrease from current state

fields.description: Unique identifier for line item (from source system)
fields.business_meaning: Links back to source proposal document

derived_fields.calculation: Derived from third_party, optional, fee_type, and category fields
derived_fields.description: Determines which section of Excel the row belongs to

derived_fields.calculation: category contains 'Core' or 'Bundle' or solution_name contains 'HORIZON'
derived_fields.description: Identifies if item is part of bundle pricing
Average monthly cost over contract term

aggregations.description: Sum of all required (not optional) monthly fees
aggregations.calculation: SUM(per_unit_rate WHERE optional=false AND fee_type IN ('Monthly F', 'Monthly V'))

aggregations.description: Sum of all one-time implementation fees
Total Cost of Ownership over 7 years
Sum of all optional monthly fees
aggregations.calculation: SUM(per_unit_rate WHERE optional=true AND fee_type IN ('Monthly F', 'Monthly V'))

relationships.description: One proposal contains many line items
Line items belong to either primary vendor or third-party vendors

validation_rules.required_field_check: fee_type, solution_name, category, per_unit_rate, third_party, optional must not be null
validation_rules.fee_type_quantity_rule: If fee_type='Monthly V', then average_monthly_qty must be > 0
validation_rules.one_time_year_rule: If fee_type='One-Time', cost should only appear in Year 1
validation_rules.confidence_score_rule: If overall_confidence < 0.8, flag for manual review
validation_rules.bundle_placement_rule: If is_bundle=true, must be in Bundle section (rows 7-20)
validation_rules.third_party_placement_rule: If third_party=true, must be in Third-Party section
validation_rules.optional_placement_rule: If optional=true, must be in Optional section (rows 121+)

cost_calculation.One-Time: year_1_cost = per_unit_rate (Year 1 only, 0 for subsequent years)

business_rules.bundle_identification: Items with category='Core' or solution_name contains 'HORIZON' or 'Bundle' → Bundle section
business_rules.item_splitting: If monthly_fee > 0 AND one_time_fee > 0, split into two rows: one Monthly, one One-Time
